title: The week ice floated into the Gulf of Mexico ❄️
subject: blizzard
description:
Could this happen again today? 👇

In February 1899, the Great Arctic Outbreak sent ice down the Mississippi past New Orleans and into the Gulf of Mexico. Florida dropped below zero for the only time on record, and a blizzard buried Washington.

Sources: NOAA, via AccuWeather, "The Snow King Blizzard: Great Arctic Outbreak of 1899"; History.com, "The Coldest Day in U.S. History" (citing the U.S. Weather Bureau and the Baltimore Sun)
tags: ice in the gulf of mexico

scenes.text: Ice floated past New Orleans into the Gulf of Mexico.
It was February 1899. Tallahassee hit minus 2 Fahrenheit, Florida's only reading below zero.
In Fort Myers, snow weighed down the palm trees.
Washington fell to minus 15, then got about 20 inches of snow. The Baltimore Sun said the Capitol looked like a snow palace.
Florida's orange crop was a total loss, and over 100 people died nationwide.
New Orleans hit 7 degrees, and the next day its Mardi Gras parade rolled anyway.
